# 2016 Elections

There was 1 election held in Jersey in 2016.

- **[Senator By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2016#e22)**

  1 seat · 11 candidates · 19.1% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

[**View a sentiment analysis of the manifestos**](https://flow.je/elections/2016/analysis)

* * *

* * *

## 2016 Senator By-Election

Following the resignation of [Zoe Cameron](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/zoe-cameron) on 12th July 2016, the Royal Court called a senatorial by-election (1 seat), 7th September 2016.

**[Sarah Ferguson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-ferguson) was elected as Senator**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Sarah Ferguson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-ferguson)** |  | 3,649 | 29.7% |
| 2 | [Sam Mézec](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sam-mezec) | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 3,518 | 28.6% |
| 3 | [Christian May](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/christian-may) |  | 2,018 | 16.4% |
| 4 | [John Young](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-young) |  | 1,240 | 10.1% |
| 5 | [Hugh Raymond](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hugh-raymond) |  | 988 | 8% |
| 6 | [Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye) |  | 254 | 2.1% |
| 7 | [Mary O’Keeffe](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-okeeffe) |  | 246 | 2% |
| 8 | [Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) |  | 139 | 1.1% |
| 9 | [Alvin Aaron](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alvin-aaron) |  | 103 | 0.8% |
| 10 | [Mike Dun](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-dun) |  | 73 | 0.6% |
| 11 | [Stevie Ocean](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stevie-ocean) |  | 70 | 0.6% |

12,304 votes (inc. 6 spoilt papers)

64,474 registered voters

19.1% turnout
